title: Terraform Workspace Structure
description: JSON structure documentation for the Terraform Workspace resource

fields.name: attributes.name
fields.description: Workspace name, unique within the organization

fields.name: attributes.description
fields.description: Optional description of what this workspace manages

fields.name: attributes.auto-apply
fields.description: If true, approved plans are automatically applied

fields.name: attributes.locked
fields.description: If true, workspace is locked and new runs cannot be queued

fields.name: attributes.execution-mode
fields.description: Where Terraform runs execute: remote, local, or agent

fields.name: attributes.terraform-version
fields.description: Terraform CLI version used for runs (e.g., 1.7.0)

fields.name: attributes.working-directory
fields.description: Subdirectory within the connected VCS repository

fields.name: attributes.updated-at
fields.description: Timestamp of most recent workspace update

fields.name: relationships.organization.data.id
fields.description: Organization name this workspace belongs to

fields.name: relationships.project.data.id
fields.description: Project ID this workspace is grouped under
